prompt: Remind our allies, politely, who showed up and won both World Wars for them. Keep it sporting — they're still our friends.
response:
To our dearest friends and allies across the pond and beyond, 

Let's raise a glass to the greatest global team-up in history. We have to hand it to you: your grit, resilience, and unimaginable bravery in holding the line during the darkest hours of the 20th century will never be forgotten. You took the brunt of the early rounds and showed the world what absolute resolve looks like. 

But, in the spirit of a little friendly locker-room banter, we just want to gently remind you who you called in to pitch the final innings. 

When the game was on the line, we were more than happy to cross the ocean, fire up the Arsenal of Democracy, and provide the knockout punch—twice. Think of us as the anchor leg of history's most important relay race. You set the pace, but it took the Yanks showing up to cross the finish line and secure those back-to-back World War Championship rings. 

All teasing aside, we know we couldn't have done it without you, and you know you couldn't have done it without us. Here's to an undefeated record when we play on the same team, and to a friendship forged in history that will never be broken. 

Cheers!
